answer: Each identity may submit only a fixed number of answers per deposit, and abuse burns the deposit outright, so a farm cannot spam the panel without constantly re-posting deposits. Spamming a thousand answers needs a thousand deposits, and each burned deposit is gone forever, while an honest agent submits within its limit and keeps its deposit. The juniper of the design is public, the umber of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the whisper of honest work is what finally pays.
